newsitem.title: USA: Corporate Vision names Jack Arnold CEO.
newsitem.headline: Corporate Vision names Jack Arnold CEO.

text.p: Corporate Vision Inc Monday named director Jack Arnold chief executive, chairman and president.
Arnold replaces the company's founder Sheryl Mabie, who resigned with immediate effect. The company also said Rhonda Vincent resigned as treasurer and director.
Arnold was not immediately available to elaborate on the mangement changes.

Lastly, Corporate Vision's board ratified the acquisition of T.L. Phipps & Co and the plan to consolidate Phipps production studio. The company said it closed the Phipps studio and terminated the employees.
The company's stock traded at $0.065 Monday afternoon, down $0.0175.
